subject.title: feat(ui): add message preview to session list

question: Should the Control UI Sessions table adopt last-message previews using the existing `sessions.list` `includeLastMessage` / `lastMessagePreview` contract?
rationale: The linked feature request is still open and product-labeled, and repairing this PR would add a visible UI behavior plus transcript-tail reads per listed row, so maintainers should confirm the UX/performance direction before sponsoring a replacement branch.

options.title: Sponsor a current-path implementation
options.body: Keep the feature request open and require this PR or a replacement PR to rebase onto the current Sessions page, use `lastMessagePreview`, add tests, and provide real UI proof.

options.title: Keep the idea open but close this branch
options.body: Preserve the canonical issue while closing this conflicting branch if maintainers do not want to repair the contributor PR.

options.title: Decline previews in the table
options.body: Close the PR and canonical issue if maintainers decide the Sessions table should not read transcript previews.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a current-path implementation
recommendation.body: Keep the feature request open and require this PR or a replacement PR to rebase onto the current Sessions page, use `lastMessagePreview`, add tests, and provide real UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest routing candidate from the current UI and preview-contract history.
